resources.string: Song recognisers
Who is asked what a clip is, in order, until one names the song. Each needs a key of yours, and each is sent the clip.
What goes into the text
Insert as
What the Insert button types. Every other shape is a chip beside it.

What the Insert button of Music ID types for a recognised song, for example the title and the artist. The other formats are offered as chips beside the button. The default is the title and the artist.
Picture style
The picture the Picture chip makes first. The others are one tap further.
The look of the picture that the Picture chip makes first for a recognised song. The other looks are one tap further.
Open in
Which store a link points to, when the song is on it
The music service that a song\'s link points to, when the song is on that service. The first the song has uses the first link the recognition service returned.
The first the song has
Listening
Listen for
How long the microphone records before asking. Longer clips match more reliably and cost the same.
How long the microphone records before the clip is sent for recognition. A longer clip is matched more reliably and costs the same as a short one. A shorter clip gives the answer sooner.
%d s
Check what the phone plays first
Read the song from the player on this phone before listening, where notification access allows it

Before it listens with the microphone, Music ID reads the song from the media player on this phone. This is instant and needs no network. It works only where you gave the keyboard notification access. This setting is on by default.

Remember the songs recognised, on this phone only
Keeps a list of the songs that Music ID recognised, so you can find one again later. The list stays on this phone.
